Mina (People Ops): Heads-up: remote hire Ana Vega starts Monday. Passport expired, SSN card available. Need I-9 plan + laptop shipping.
Eli - IT: Expired passport won't work for List A. Use DL + SSN card combo. Which state DL?
Mina (People Ops): Driving license from WA. She can upload DL and SSN image. We'll require physical docs by day 3.
Carmen (HR): Confirming: remote verification via Zoom Section 2 completed by HR rep, then physical docs dropped at nearest office within 3 business days. I'll book a 1pm Zoom slot on Monday.
OnboardBot: Background check: clear. Badge not required for remote.
Eli - IT: For laptop ship, prefer mac. Need full legal name for DEP and shipping address. DM me. I'll mark loaner until docs are filed.
Mina (People Ops): Sent DM with name/address. Carmen, can you join the Zoom to complete Section 2? Also please add the exception note in the new-hire folder.
Carmen (HR): Yes I'll join. I'll log the exception handling steps in the HR system and email candidate the I-9 checklist link.
Mina (People Ops): Quick checklist: 1) Zoom I-9 Monday 13:00, 2) Laptop shipped overnight, 3) Physical docs due by Thu, 4) Loaner access until verification. React when done.
Eli - IT: :white_check_mark: laptop shipped (tracking sent DM).
Carmen (HR): :white_check_mark: Zoom scheduled and I-9 entry created.
Mina (People Ops): Thanks everyone.
